answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 15949 Country: Pakistan Title: In Quetta, Pakistan, there are a lot of commodities which are smuggled from various countries are available with high quality. My question is that if I purchase such products from there on less prices and sell it in some other city on higher prices. Would it be halal on not? Question: In Quetta, Pakistan, there are a lot of commodities which are smuggled from various countries are available with high quality. My question is that if I purchase such products from there on less prices and sell it in some other city on higher prices. Would it be halal on not? Condition: I'm not smuggling, but I'm purchasing the product which is smuggled. Thanking you in anticipation. Answer ID: 15949 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1508/1516/M=1430) If you deal in lawful and halal items, the income will not be termed as haram , but one should avoid such a business which is against law or which endangers life and honour. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
